Plan: chip NAIP imagery, reuse Clay v1.5 NAIP embeddings for retrieval, generate captions with a vision-language model, and validate captions by retrieval recall on held-out queries such as 'railroads'. Limitations: caption quality depends on the captioning model; NAIP is US-only.

VERDICT: approve
